parrafo_1.es: Heritage Ink Tattoo Company es un estudio en Jacksonville con artistas como Artie, especializados en realismo, color, black and grey y fine line. El local tiene un lounge comodo y una pared completa de flash.
parrafo_1.en: Heritage Ink Tattoo Company is a Jacksonville studio with artists like Artie, specializing in realism, color, black and grey and fine line. The shop has a comfortable lounge and a full wall of flash art.

parrafo_2.es: Reseña tras reseña dicen lo mismo: familiar, honesto y limpio. Amanda Coleman y su esposo se tatuaron juntos y ambos quedaron encantados con el resultado y el trato.
parrafo_2.en: Review after review says the same thing: family-oriented, honest and clean. Amanda Coleman and her husband got tattooed together and both left thrilled with the result and the way they were treated.

items.quote: Amazing place! My husband and I both got tattoos and they turned out perfect. The owners and our artist are such great people, friendly, honest, respectful. The shop was clean and welcoming. If you're looking for an awesome tattoo this is the place to go.
I had a wonderful experience. Family oriented, Artie is an amazing artist. I got my 1st ever finger tattoos, barely felt anything. Amazing work, amazing atmosphere! Highly recommend!!

We had such a great experience at Heritage Ink Tattoo Company! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming, and everyone was incredibly friendly. The entire shop had a great vibe that made us feel comfortable and at ease...
